common.decoder_requirement: Use a decoder generated from a compatible frozen dialect.

serialization_rules.rule: Stable-sort non-extension fields by native element size 8, 4, 2, 1 bytes; preserve XML order within equal sizes.
Order arrays by element type size, not total array size.
Fields after <extensions/> are MAVLink 2 fields, remain in XML declaration order, and are excluded from CRC_EXTRA.
A receiver with extension fields sees zero when the sender does not have those extension fields; zero is not proof that an explicit zero measurement was transmitted.
Trailing zero bytes are omitted on the wire and restored as zero during decoding; a shortened payload can be valid.

field_metadata_rules.rule: Treat as fixed wire primitive and element count. Treat char arrays as strings only when the field description defines string termination.
Record the specified physical or encoded unit; do not apply an additional undocumented scale.
Apply the frozen XML multiplier exactly once.
Map known raw values; preserve unknown values as UNKNOWN(raw).
Decode as combinable bits, not as mutually exclusive values.
Use only the exact frozen-field declaration. Support scalar, [value], [value:], and positional-array notation. Use isnan for NaN. Absence of invalid metadata does not authorize an invented sentinel.
Include the instance value in the observation key.
Store wip, superseded, and deprecated independently from support status.

parameter_id.termination: NUL if shorter than 16 human-readable characters; no NUL when exactly 16

encodings.name: byte-wise
encodings.constraint: The carrier is only four bytes. Do not infer lossless transport for a native value wider than the carrier.

encodings.name: C-style cast
encodings.constraint: Float has only 24 bits of integer precision, so larger integer values may lose precision.

param.support_constraint: The type enum lists more types than any particular implementation necessarily supports.
param.write_response: PARAM_VALUE broadcasts the current value; no benchmark timeout constant is supplied by XML.

param_ext.write_response: PARAM_EXT_ACK can distinguish accepted, failed, in-progress, and unsupported.

implementation_boundaries: ArduPilot parameter sets vary by vehicle and release; hidden parameters can change param_count and param_index.
PX4 v1.17 documents a native flat table of float and int32_t parameters, with metadata and code definitions.
Presence of PARAM_EXT definitions does not prove that either flight controller exposes its flight-control configuration table through PARAM_EXT.
PX4 v1.17 documents Extended Parameter support in some form for camera-definition string parameters; that statement is not generalized here.

Explicit frozen-source dispatch plus decode/handler with satisfied build conditions.

support_state_model.meaning: A static outbound candidate path exists.

support_state_model.minimum_evidence: A generic request mechanism plus message-specific stream registration/request handler, or a controlled runtime request with an explicit response.
support_state_model.meaning: The message is a requestable-send candidate.

support_state_model.minimum_evidence: Current build, vehicle, port, profile, and parameter configuration resolves to a default stream.
Directional capture with interface/channel, host time, source identity, message, and fields.
support_state_model.meaning: The frame entered the observation point during this run.

support_state_model.minimum_evidence: Directional capture with interface/channel, host time, source identity, and forwarded-frame handling.
support_state_model.meaning: The frame left the observation point during this run.

support_state_model.minimum_evidence: Runtime observation plus adequate field semantics, validity, instance identity, provenance, and clock domain for the proposition.
support_state_model.meaning: The field can directly support the stated proposition in the captured run.

observability_rules: Incoming and outgoing support are separate dimensions.
Requestable and default-streaming status are separate dimensions.
Requestable and runtime-observed status are separate dimensions.
A forwarded frame is attributed to its source sysid/compid, not automatically to the flight controller.
A frame captured on a flight-controller link is not by itself proof that the flight controller generated it.
A missing frame is not proof that the represented state did not occur.
PX4 XML presence requires separate stream-list evidence for TX and handler/dispatch evidence for RX.
ArduPilot generic SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL or REQUEST_MESSAGE support does not prove that every msgid is requestable.

time_semantics.official_fact: The frozen field descriptions state time since system boot.

derived_wrap.provenance: Audit arithmetic inference from frozen type and unit, not a quoted XML constant.

time_semantics.monitor_rule: Compare only within the same source and boot session; handle wrap; split traces on reboot or unresolved wrap/reordering.
time_semantics.forbidden_inference: Unix epoch or host boot time

time_semantics.official_fact: SYSTEM_TIME describes sender master time and recommends TIMESYNC for precise synchronization.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Keep paired with the same message's time_boot_ms and source identity; quantify mapping error before cross-clock MITL use.
forbidden_inferences: Assume zero is invalid when the frozen XML has no invalid attribute

time_semantics.official_fact: Frozen XML definitions vary between Unix-or-boot, boot-only, and synchronized-Unix-or-boot.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Register clock domain for each message.field; use AMBIGUOUS_SPEC when the frozen description is not operationally decidable.
time_semantics.forbidden_inference: A global clock domain based only on the field name

time_semantics.frozen_description: Unix epoch time or time since system boot, infer by magnitude
time_semantics.reason: A uint32_t microsecond value cannot reliably carry contemporary Unix epoch microseconds, and the XML supplies no decision threshold.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Do not automatically convert to epoch; require version-specific implementation evidence and runtime calibration.

time_semantics.unit: ms within GPS week plus GPS week number
time_semantics.official_fact: time_week_ms is time from start of GPS week; time_week is GPS week number.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Capture both fields; treat week boundary as expected; use an explicit time-scale and leap-second policy for Unix conversion.
forbidden_inferences: Use time_week_ms alone as global monotonic time
Invent a receiver rollover rule not present in frozen XML

time_semantics.official_fact: A request uses tc1=0 and requester time in ts1; a response mirrors ts1 and places responder time in tc1. Repetition and filtering estimate offset; congestion and processing time vary RTT.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Store paired request/response, RTT, offset samples, filtering method, sample interval, and residual uncertainty.
forbidden_inferences: TIMESYNC timestamps are event timestamps for unrelated messages
A tool-specific 10 ms cutoff is a MAVLink-wide MITL epsilon

time_semantics.audit_inference: Arrival occurs after scheduling, routing, serialization, transport, host queue, and parsing delays.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Record clock API, capture point, interface, direction, and measured uncertainty. Prefer a monotonic clock for durations.
time_semantics.forbidden_inference: Treat arrival time as source event time without an error budget

time_semantics.official_fact: Used for packet-loss detection and incremented per sent message.
time_semantics.monitor_rule: Use only as a per-source loss/reordering clue and handle modulo-256 wrap.
time_semantics.forbidden_inference: Use as a timestamp or global event sequence

officially_documented_sources: ArduPilot parameter/waypoint transfer may temporarily slow requested stream rates by four times or more.
PX4 MAV_X_RATE is a combined cap and reduces individual message rates when the total exceeds it.
TIMESYNC RTT varies with link congestion and processing time.
Routing and forwarding can add extra hops.
timing_uncertainty.decision_rule: If a temporal proposition lacks a common embedded clock or a measured arrival-time error budget, report INCONCLUSIVE rather than PASS or FAIL.

frozen_evidence.supports: ArduPilot generates from all.xml into a v2.0 output tree.
Wide include closure contains development and test dialects; generation is not support.
PX4 SITL chooses development and generates MAVLink 2.0 primary and uAvionix headers.
Development includes common and belongs to the WIP definition domain.
Both frozen generators use payload 255, v2 header 10 including STX, checksum 2, optional trailer 13, and the same max-packet formula.
ArduPilot-frozen SYSTEM_TIME, ambiguous SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW time, TIMESYNC, GPS week, boot-only, and synchronized-or-boot time definitions.
PX4-frozen SYSTEM_TIME, TIMESYNC with target extensions, and GPS week fields.
Frozen regular and extended parameter carriers and type enums.
PX4-frozen regular and extended parameter wire definitions.
ArduPilot-frozen command carrier fields without field-level invalid attributes.
PX4-frozen command carrier fields with NaN and INT32_MAX invalid metadata.
Concrete frozen examples of extensions, multipliers, arrays, bitmasks, and scalar/array invalid syntax.

downstream_requirements: Record system, SUT commit, MAVLink commit, dialect entrypoint, XML path, and XML hash.
Record message id/name and full frozen field metadata: type, array, extension, units, multiplier, enum/bitmask, invalid, instance, lifecycle.
Keep RX, TX, requestable, and default-stream evidence in separate columns.
Keep runtime capture evidence separate and use NOT_RUN_NO_CAPTURE when absent.
Record producer identity and do not attribute forwarded frames to the flight controller without source evidence.
Register clock domain and wrap for every timestamp field; interpret time_usec per message.field.
Use DIRECT, DERIVED_WITH_ASSUMPTIONS, NOT_DIRECT, or INCONCLUSIVE for proposition observability.
Record SPEC_DRIFT whenever rolling documentation and frozen XML differ; use frozen values for system decoding.
Do not invent a temporal epsilon.
unresolved_questions: No directional runtime capture exists for either SUT.
Message-by-message static RX, TX, requestability, and default-stream scans remain to be completed.
It is not established that either flight controller exposes its flight-control configuration table through PARAM_EXT.
No measured Unix/GPS/boot clock mapping or leap-second/time-scale policy exists.
No link, scheduler, queue, routing, or host-capture delay distribution exists; no numeric epsilon is justified.
SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW.time_usec remains AMBIGUOUS_SPEC until version-specific implementation and runtime evidence are added.
ArduPilot Dev pages are rolling; publication-grade replay would benefit from a fixed page-content hash or a document commit paired to the SUT revision.
